change_significance.description: Required when action=submitted. major=backward-incompatible; minor=backward-compatible feature; patch=fix. YOU own this level - a reviewer may raise it but can never lower it.

merge_order.description: REQUIRED when this task's MRs span more than one repo: the Repository CR names in dependency order, first-merged first. There is NO default. Get it wrong and a downstream repo ships against an API that has not merged yet.

reason.description: Required when action=discuss: why you are pausing instead of finishing this turn with submitted or declined. The operator parks the task awaiting human input; the next human comment on an owned issue or MR resumes it.
